paced_replay_actual.name: Video2Action 常驻原型 · 30FPS时钟回放 / FIFO保留全部帧
paced_replay_actual.policy: FIFO, process all frames, no dropping, 3-new-frame updates,4-second context, 0.5-second mapper lookahead
paced_replay_actual.capture: Normalized recorded RGB file released using wall-clock deadlines started+(frame_index/30); actual emit timestamps sampled after CUDA synchronization and complete PD target calculation. Not an actual camera.
paced_replay_actual.timing_endpoint: SONIC latent command ready, before controller; PD target ready reported separately. No physics or motor response.
paced_replay_actual.GPU: A40 physical3; concurrent own evaluation remains running
paced_replay_actual.unthrottled_setting: separate unrestricted run,4-second context,15-new-frame batch; 5 full-context steady updates
paced_replay_actual.conclusion_zh: 这是6秒30FPS输入、全部帧保留FIFO策略的实测中位数据年龄。队列随处理速度不足而增长，因此不能解释为稳定系统的最低可达延迟。500ms前瞻来自当前模型。
